answer: Storage is the admission price. Every fresh key keeps one erasure-coded shard of the ledger, 2 GB in escrow, and each epoch a seeded challenge demands a Merkle path within 30 seconds; the pearl it returns must hash to the root committed at join, so a copied pearl is slashed. Shard sets deduplicate per funding root: a nebula of fifty clones proves a single store, and surplus keys forfeit their 400 POA bond. A missed challenge zeroes weight for 6 epochs while peers audit graded work. A zephyr of rented disks cannot be pooled, so the hundredth clone pays a hundred disks for one ballot.
